subject.title: [Feature]: Enhance  with failure summary and fix suggestions

question: Should OpenClaw core add a `sessions diagnose` CLI/JSON contract, and what redaction policy, failure taxonomy, and stable output fields should it expose?
rationale: The request is useful and aligned with CLI ergonomics, but it adds a new public diagnostic surface that can reveal sensitive session/tool context and create long-lived JSON semantics.

options.title: Approve a scoped core design
options.body: Define the redaction boundary, failure categories, and JSON stability contract first, then accept a narrow implementation against the sessions and trajectory data paths.

options.title: Keep current troubleshooting tools
options.body: Leave `sessions tail` and `export-trajectory` as the supported paths and decline the new command until demand or a clearer schema emerges.

options.title: Prototype outside core first
options.body: Encourage an external script or fork proof while maintainers evaluate whether the output belongs in the supported CLI surface.

recommendation.title: Approve a scoped core design
recommendation.body: Define the redaction boundary, failure categories, and JSON stability contract first, then accept a narrow implementation against the sessions and trajectory data paths.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history ties this owner most directly to the sessions command/docs surface and CLI command behavior decisions.
